extracted.name: Courgette fritters
extracted.description: Use grated courgette to make a simple but delicious summery starter or light supper with just five main ingredients. Use up a glut from the garden
ingredient_lines: 25g finely grated parmesan, or vegetarian alternative (optional)
170g tub roasted red pepper hummus to serve
instruction_lines: Combine the grated courgette, flour, egg and parmesan in a large bowl.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and add the oil. Fry the fritters for 2-3 mins on each side until golden brown. Serve straight away with red pepper hummus.
